title: Predicting cellular responses to complex perturbations in high‐throughput screens
authors: Mohammad Lotfollahi, Anna Klimovskaia Susmelj, Carlo De Donno, Leon Hetzel, Yuge Ji, Ignacio L Ibarr...
abstract: The compositional perturbation autoencoder (CPA) was developed to predict cellular responses to complex perturbations in high-throughput screens. CPA accurately predicts unseen drug combinations and genetic interactions at the single-cell level, outperforming baseline models.
